svg.title: Merkle trees
svg.desc: Two replicas build hash trees over keys 0 to 999. Replica B goes offline and misses writes to keys 750 to 999, so A's leaf, branch, and root hashes change. Repair compares roots, 9f2c against 41d7, then only the children that differ, skipping the matching left half and keys 500 to 749. Only keys 750 to 999 are copied to B, and the roots match again.
svg.text: Roots differ, so they follow only the mismatches and copy one range.
